nodes.question: What is the significance of electric buses in urban centres, and why are they expected to become increasingly important?
nodes.answer: Electric buses are very popular and are expected to become increasingly important, especially in urban centres due to their environmental benefits and potential to reduce carbon emissions and pollution.
